courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 小灣水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「效率試驗不確定度」與「疲勞循環累積」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；小灣水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Efficiency test uncertainty" and "Fatigue cycle accumulation" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Xiaowan Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦大型法蘭西斯轉輪更新與證據鏈；小灣水壩則以強震區高拱壩與岸坡耦合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on large Francis runner renewal and evidence chains; Xiaowan Dam centres on high arch dam and abutment slopes in seismic terrain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「效率試驗不確定度」與「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到小灣水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「季節調蓄水量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Efficiency test uncertainty” and “Elastic rebound after excavation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Xiaowan Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Seasonal storage water balance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.summary: 古里水壩：大型法蘭西斯轉輪更新與證據鏈。
courses.summaryEn: Guri Dam: Large Francis runner renewal and evidence chains.
courses.connection: 從「效率試驗不確定度」追到「更新停機能量機會」；地圖提供公開工程的地理脈絡。
courses.connectionEn: Trace the structure from “Efficiency test uncertainty” to “Renewal outage energy opportunity”; the map gives public geographic context.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 古里水壩
history.text: 供應商紀錄描述古里第二發電廠五部機組更新，並記載二〇一二年安裝大型法蘭西斯轉輪。文中的七百七十兆瓦是轉輪相關最大功率尺度，不能當作全廠裝機容量，也不能與名目功率混用。本課據此研究設備更新如何驗證，不推定未讀得的壩體施工年代或當前所有設備狀態。歷史監測手冊只是比較文獻，原創測試輸入及二〇二六年覆核日期另列，避免把教材算式寫成供應商保證。
history.textEn: The supplier account describes modernization of five units in Guri powerhouse No. 2 and installation of a large Francis runner in 2012. Its 770 MW figure concerns maximum runner-related power, not total plant capacity or nominal output. The course uses this evidence to examine verification of renewal without inferring unread dam-construction dates or present condition of every unit. Instrumentation literature supplies bibliographic context; original test inputs and the 2026 review date are separate from any supplier performance guarantee.

history.title: 古里水壩
history.text: 墾務局監測手冊出版，這是參考文獻年代而非本壩施工年份
history.textEn: Reclamation instrumentation manuals are published; this dates references rather than construction of this dam

history.title: 古里水壩
history.text: 供應商記錄大型轉輪安裝，屬機組更新而非整壩落成
history.textEn: A supplier records large-runner installation, a unit-renewal event rather than dam completion

history.title: 古里水壩
history.text: 本課核對公開來源並重算原創假想模型，屬教材修訂日期
history.textEn: This course verifies public references and recomputes original hypothetical models, a curriculum revision date

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「效率試驗不確定度」到「更新停機能量機會」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Efficiency test uncertainty" through "Renewal outage energy opportunity" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
